programme.title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
programme.desc: Elle Woods (Reese Witherspoon) journeys to Washington, D.C., to have her say about animal rights, but is ignored by every politician she encounters and quickly learns that the White House can be even tougher to navigate than the Ivy League. Finally, Elle makes the acquaintance of sympathetic Rep. Victoria Rudd (Sally Field), who helps the young lawyer get her foot in the door of Congress. Unfortunately, Elle still has to convince the entire legislature to hear her out.

programme.title: The Preacher's Wife
programme.desc: A cleric begins to doubt himself and is visited by an angel. The heavenly emissary is supposed to help the good reverend over his midlife crisis, but he is distracted by the cleric's lovely young wife. A remake with gospel music of the "The Bishop's Wife".

programme.title: Body of Evidence
programme.desc: When an elderly millionaire is found dead with cocaine in his system, his will leaves $8 million to Rebecca Carlson (Madonna), who was having an affair with him. District attorney Robert Garrett (Joe Mantegna) decides to prosecute Rebecca, arguing that she deliberately engaged in wild sex with the old man to overexcite him and lead to his premature death. Defense attorney Frank Dulaney (Willem Dafoe) defends Rebecca in court while getting sucked into a dangerous affair with her.

programme.title: Midnight Cowboy
programme.desc: Convinced of his irresistible appeal to women, Texas dishwasher Joe Buck (Jon Voight) quits his job and heads for New York City, thinking he'll latch on to some rich dowager. New York, however, is not as hospitable as he imagined, and Joe soon finds himself living in an abandoned building with a Dickensian layabout named Enrico Ratso Rizzo (Dustin Hoffman). The two form a rough alliance, and together they kick-start Joe's hustling career just as Ratso's health begins to deteriorate.

programme.title: Roman Holiday
programme.desc: Overwhelmed by her suffocating schedule, touring European princess Ann takes off for a night while in Rome. When a sedative she took from her doctor kicks in, however, she falls asleep on a park bench and is found by an American reporter, Joe Bradley, who takes her back to his apartment for safety. At work the next morning, Joe finds out Ann's regal identity and bets his editor he can get exclusive interview with her, but romance soon gets in the way.

programme.title: Max 2: White House Hero
programme.desc: Max, a military service dog, is assigned to serve on the U.S. president's Secret Service detail.

programme.title: Days of Heaven
programme.desc: A screen poem about life in America at the turn of the century. A story of love and murder told through the voice of a child and expressive images of nature in 1916. A steelworker flees Chicago after a fight with his boss; he takes his little sister and girlfriend with him.

programme.title: Regretting You
programme.desc: When a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal, Morgan Grant and her daughter, Clara, explore what's left behind as they confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover each other.

programme.title: The American President
programme.desc: With the end of his first term in sight, widowed U.S. President Andrew Shepherd (Michael Douglas) knows that overwhelming public support will guarantee his re-election. But when he falls in love with lobbyist Sydney Ellen Wade (Annette Bening), Shepherd's supporters question the relationship, and his approval ratings drop. As a rival presidential candidate goes on the attack, Shepherd must choose between his political career and his love for Sydney.

programme.title: Backdraft
programme.desc: Chicago firefighting brothers Stephen (Kurt Russell) and Brian (William Baldwin) have been rivals since childhood. Brian, struggling to prove himself, transfers to the arson unit. There he aids Don (Robert De Niro) in his investigation into a spate of fires involving oxygen-induced infernos called backdrafts. But when a conspiracy implicating a crooked politician and an arsonist leads Brian back to Stephen, he is forced to overcome his brotherly competitiveness in order to crack the case.

programme.title: We Stand Alone Together: The Men of Easy Company
programme.desc: In 1943, U.S. troops ship out to engage in combat behind enemy lines during World War II.

programme.title: Aquaman
programme.desc: Once home to the most advanced civilization on Earth, the city of Atlantis is now an underwater kingdom ruled by the power-hungry King Orm. With a vast army at his disposal, Orm plans to conquer the remaining oceanic people -- and then the surface world. Standing in his way is Aquaman, Orm's half-human, half-Atlantean brother and true heir to the throne. With help from royal counselor Vulko, Aquaman must retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan and embrace his destiny as protector of the deep.

programme.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
programme.desc: After failing to defeat Aquaman the first time, Black Manta wields the power of the mythic Black Trident to unleash an ancient and malevolent force. Hoping to end his reign of terror, Aquaman forges an unlikely alliance with his brother, Orm, the former king of Atlantis. Setting aside their differences, they join forces to protect their kingdom and save the world from irreversible destruction.

programme.title: Madame Web
programme.desc: Cassandra Webb is a New York City paramedic who starts to show signs of clairvoyance. Forced to confront revelations about her past, she must protect three young women from a mysterious adversary who wants them dead.

programme.title: Supergirl
programme.desc: Kara (Helen Slater) of Argo City poses as Clark Kent's cousin, Linda Lee, to recover the Omegahedron from a witch (Faye Dunaway).

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: Disowned by his obscenely wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

programme.title: Parthenope
programme.desc: The beautiful Parthenope searches for love in the heady, hot summers and endless nights of her youth in Naples, Italy, as she falls for the city's many unforgettable characters and finds herself in the adventures that make up a lifetime.

programme.title: Anatomy of a Fall
programme.desc: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

programme.title: The Commandant's Shadow
programme.desc: Hans Jürgen Höss, the 87-year-old son of Rudolf Höss, as he faces his father's terrible legacy for the first time. His father was the camp commandant of Auschwitz and masterminded the murder of over a million Jews. While Hans Jürgen Höss enjoyed a happy childhood playing with many toys in the family villa at Auschwitz, Jewish cellist Anita Lasker-Wallfisch was playing for her life to survive the notorious concentration camp.

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Animal pals Alex (Ben Stiller), Marty (Chris Rock), Melman (David Schwimmer) and Gloria (Jada Pinkett Smith) are still trying to make it back to New York's Central Park Zoo. They are forced to take a detour to Europe to find the penguins and chimps who broke the bank at a Monte Carlo casino. When French animal-control officer Capitaine Chantel DuBois (Frances McDormand) picks up their scent, Alex and company are forced to hide out in a traveling circus.

programme.title: The Legend of Ochi
programme.desc: In a remote village on the island of Carpathia, a shy farm girl named Yuri is raised to fear elusive animals known as ochi. But when Yuri discovers a wounded baby ochi has been left behind, she escapes on a quest to bring him home.

programme.title: The Land of Sometimes
programme.desc: Twins Alfie and Elise summon a mysterious Wish Collector and get whisked away to a fantastical realm that's filled with magical creatures and surprises at every turn.

programme.title: Ready Player One
programme.desc: In 2045, the creator of a virtual reality universe promises his fortune to the first person to discover a digital Easter egg. Soon, young Wade Watts finds himself in a reality-bending treasure hunt through the mysterious and fantastical world.

programme.title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
programme.desc: Thomas leads some escaped Gladers on their final and most dangerous mission yet. To save their friends, they must break into the legendary Last City, a WCKD-controlled labyrinth that may turn out to be the deadliest maze of all. Anyone who makes it out alive will get answers to the questions that the Gladers have been asking since they arrived in the maze.

programme.title: The Long Walk
programme.desc: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

programme.title: Final Destination
programme.desc: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper.

programme.title: Final Destination 2
programme.desc: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway.

programme.title: Final Destination 3
programme.desc: Six years after a group of high-school students first cheated death, another teen (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) has a premonition that she and her friends will be involved in a horrifying roller-coaster accident. When the vision proves true, the student and her fellow survivors must deal with the repercussions of cheating the Grim Reaper.

programme.title: Final Destination 5
programme.desc: During a bus ride with his colleagues to a corporate retreat, Sam (Nicholas D'Agosto) experiences a horrifying vision: the suspension bridge that they -- and many others -- are crossing starts to crumble around them. When his vision ends and, almost immediately, starts to come true, Sam takes quick action that saves a number of people, including his girlfriend, Molly (Emma Bell), and his best friend, Peter (Miles Fisher). However, the survivors soon find that Death will not be denied.

programme.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
programme.desc: Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

programme.title: The Hole in the Ground
programme.desc: One night, Sarah's young son disappears into the woods behind their rural home. When he returns, he looks the same, but his behavior grows increasingly disturbing. Sarah begins to believe that the boy who returned may not be her son at all.

programme.title: Chernobyl: The Lost Tapes
programme.desc: The story of Chernobyl told through a newly discovered hoard of dramatic footage filmed at the nuclear plant during the disaster and newly-recorded, deeply personal interviews of those who were there.

programme.title: Fukushima: A Nuclear Nightmare
programme.desc: Reconstructing the nine harrowing days following the disaster in forensic, real-time detail, from the control-room engineers fighting to prevent a total meltdown, to the political leaders confronting the unthinkable, to ordinary citizens caught in the fallout. Power plant workers who were tasked with averting a major catastrophe by doing a potential suicide mission. These 50 workers recount the mounting pressures they faced as they entered the darkened reactors to try to avert the worst outcome.

programme.title: Cocktail
programme.desc: Brian Flanagan (Tom Cruise) wants a high-paying marketing job, but needs a business degree first. Working as a bartender to pay for college, Flanagan is mentored by his veteran boss, Doug Coughlin (Bryan Brown). Together, their showy tricks and charisma command large crowds and tip payments -- until Flanagan and the cynical Coughlin have a falling out. Flanagan moves to Jamaica to raise enough money to open his own bar, where he falls in love with artist Jordan Mooney (Elisabeth Shue).

programme.title: Rain Man
programme.desc: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt (Tom Cruise) learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has an autistic older brother named Raymond (Dustin Hoffman) and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinos while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

programme.title: Deadpool 2
programme.desc: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool meets Russell, an angry teenage mutant who lives at an orphanage. When Russell becomes the target of Cable -- a genetically enhanced soldier from the future -- Deadpool realizes that he'll need some help saving the boy from such a superior enemy. He soon joins forces with Bedlam, Shatterstar, Domino and other powerful mutants to protect young Russell from Cable and his advanced weaponry.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha tòrr a’ gabhail àite an-diugh nuair a tha Bing agus a’ charaidean a-dol dhan choille airson dealbhan-duilleig a tharraing ach chan eil e furasta nuair a tha a’ ghaoth ag èirigh. There’s a lot happening when Bing and friends make leaf pictures in the forest, but the wind doesn’t make things easy for them.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha einnsean-smàlaidh sa phàirc, tha Sula agus Pando a' faihinn cothrom air suidhe na bhroinn ach tha Bing tàmailteach nuair a tha aig an einnsean-smàlaidh ri falbh ann an cabhaig. When a fire engine is displayed in the park, Sula and Pando get the opportunity to sit inside it, but Bing is disappointed when it needs to leave in a hurry.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Thig air turas eile sgoinneil le na h-Abadas. 'S e 'put' am facal ùr a tha aca. Cò a thèid air a thòrr an-diugh: Hari, Ela, neo Seren? Join the Abadas for another 'abadobedee' adventure. This episode's word is 'buoy'. Who will be chosen to find today's exciting new word; Hari, Ela or Seren?

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ‘S e latha ciùin a th’ ann, ach tha Nìp a’ cladhach thuill air feadh an eilein, is cha stad e. Tha Àtaidh is Tilidh a’ feuchainn ri obrachadh a-mach gu dè tha ga fhàgail air bhioran mar seo. Feumaidh gur e a cho-là-breith a th’ ann! It is a peaceful day but Neep is digging holes all over the Island and won’t stop. Abney and Teal try to work out why he is so excited. It must be his birthday!

programme.title: ’S E Iasg a Th’Annam (I’m a Fish)
programme.desc: Tha an t-Iasg Garibaldi ag innse dhuinn mar a tha ìomhaigh aige ri chumail suas, mar a bhios e a' lorg a charaid, agus mar a bhios e a’ coimhead às deidh nead làn uighean The Garibaldi Fish tells us how he has an image to uphold, the way he finds his mate and how he looks after a nest full of eggs.

programme.title: Orain CBeebies
programme.desc: Taghadh farsaing de dh’òrain bho Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh agus sgioba CBeebies ALBA. A selection of songs from Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh and the CBeebies ALBA presenters.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Mòrag Anna NicNèill a’ leughadh Chan Fhaic Cearcan san Dorchadas. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Kristyna Litten agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Morag Ann MacNeil reads Chan Fhaic Cearcan san Dorchadas, written and illustrated by Kristyna Litten and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair tha Bonns is Uilidh a' sàbhaladh Throig bhon Bhògais-shìd’, tha e uabhasach neo-thaingeil. Cho neo-thaingeil ‘s gu bheil e a' tilleadh air ais chun na Bògaisean. Ach tha e ag ionnsachadh gu bheil caraidean feumail aig a' cheann thall! When Bonns and Uilidh save Troig from Bògais-shìd’, he is very ungrateful. So much so, that he returns to see the Bògaisean. However, he learns that friends are helpful, at the end of the day!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha Uilidh airson dearbhadh gu bheil e treun – dìreach mar an Gumbal gun Ainm. Ciamar a thèid dha? Bheil e treun no bheil e dìreach gòrach? Uilidh wants to prove that he is a hero just like the Un-named Gumbal. How will he get on? Is he brave or is he just foolish?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Bitzer air crìoch a chuir air an obair-taighe gu lèir agus a-nis chan eil càil aige ri dhèanamh. The e air a dhòigh nuair a mhothachas e gu bheil an t-sabhal feumach air sgioblachadh - gus an tig e tairsinn air dealbh nach gabh a chrochadh gu dìreach! Bitzer has completed all his chores and is at a bit of a loss. He's delighted when he discovers the flock's barn needs a good tidy-up, until he comes across a wonky picture that just won't hang straight.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda, Flòraidh is Daibhidh a’ feuchainn ri bràistean Sgùdan Sporais às ùr a chosnadh. Air sgàth sin, tha 'ad dol a’ shireadh planntraisean annasach ionadail – agus abair g’ eil sin na chuairt-dànachd glè inntinneach. Hilda, Flòraidh and Daibhidh are trying to earn new Sgùdan Sporrais badges. They go in search of rare, local plants, and this turns into a very interesting adventure.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Abair gu bheil maorach a’ còrdadh ri na seòid agus anns a’ phrògram-sa, tha iad a’ còcaireachd le crùbag, rud air a bheilear tric a’ dèanamh dearmaid. Tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh ciad cùrsa dathte a’ cleachdadh feòil chrùbaig dhonn agus deiseag. Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh Linguine Crùbaig fhad ’s a tha Ùisdean cuideachd a’ dèanamh pasta, Ravioli air a lìonadh le feòil crùbaig agus bisque crùbaig. Aig deireadh gnothaich, tha Ruairidh a’ cruthachadh biadh sònraichte, spring rolls crùbaig teth is fuar. The lads love seafood, and the often overlooked and underrated crab features in this episode. Uisdean prepares a colourful crab starter using brown and velvet crab meat. Ruaridh makes an interesting crab linguini while Uisdean continues the pasta thread by making ravioli filled with crab meat and a crab bisque. To finish, Ruaridh creates a speciality, hot and cold crab spring rolls. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Singer and Gaelic teacher Margaret Macleod Nicholson is Joy’s studio guest, and Calum Maclean visits Scotland’s newest city and once ancient capital, Dunfermline.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Port An Obain
programme.desc: We meet Oban resident Duncan MacNeil, who works as a Gaelic officer, and also Sileas Sinclair, who keeps alive the family passion for traditional music.

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Mu dheireadh thall, tha a triùir leanabain aig Kinga na gàirdeanan, fhad ’s a tha Emily a’ dol tro dheuchainnean a bharrachd. Tha fradharc Diane ann an cunnart, gheibh Treasa agus Ian naidheachd a dh’fhàgas an cridheachan briste, agus tha Tom Òg a’ ruighinn clach-mhìle chudromach. Kinga finally holds her triplets together, while Emily undergoes further tests. Diane faces a risk to her sight, Treasa and Ian receive devastating news, and Tom Óg reaches a key milestone. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Tha am bard fhathast a' feitheamh cobhair ach chaneil sgeul air a bhata-teasairginn ach tha a sgioba sin air an cul a chuir ri treanadh agus fior suidheachadh eiginneach rompa. Tha croitear agus a chuid chaorach air a dhol a-mach air a cheile. Torquil Farquhar has just been left stranded on a dummy iceberg in Fraochy Bay as the lifeboat abandons its training session and heads off to a real life emergency. A local crofter is being held hostage by his mutinous sheep.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: An greimean lòin as fheàrr le Abigail, 's e Buntàta Cruasbach Sàiste. 'Ad cho blast' 's a tha 'ad rin ithe. Tha 'n seòrs' aice-se soirbh a dhèanamh; feumaidh tu fheuchainn. Abigail’s favourite snack lunch is crispy sage potatoes. It's as nice to look at as to eat and her version is easy to make - you must try it! In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Angela and Katie compete against Shonnie and Calum from rival company Sgiobalta. It’s an upstairs-downstairs, girls v boys clean-off where the winner gets the contract. Things get messy, featuring stains, smudges and romantic complications. The timing isn’t perfect, as it clashes with the anniversary of Katie’s infamous disastrous reality TV appearance. Meanwhile, Betty and Dido are on a publicity push where they ditch leaflets and embrace dancing on social media. And Daniel makes a new furry friend as he gets busy with his air freshener.

programme.title: An t-Uisge/Rain Stories
programme.desc: Anne Lundon hears about acid rain, first identified after the Industrial Revolution.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: A’ sireadh Dànachd anns an Roinn Eòrpa, tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal gu dùthaich nam beann iongantach – Nirribhidh. Còmhla ri a chompanach sreap, Calum Gibb, bidh Coinneach a’ dìreadh ‘Stetind’, stùc le eachdraidh bheairteach a tha air mac-meanmna luchd-sreap a ghlacadh airson còrr is ceud bliadhna. Seeking adventure on a grand scale in Europe, Coinneach Rankin travels to the mountain paradise of Norway. Along with his climbing partner, Calum Gibb, Coinneach makes an ascent of Stetind, a peak with a storied past that has captured the imagination of mountaineers for well over a century. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Thig air turas eile sgoinneil le na h-Abadas. 'S e 'put' am facal ùr a tha aca. Cò a thèid air a thòrr an-diugh: Hari, Ela, neo Seren? Join the Abadas for another 'abadobedee' adventure. This episode's word is 'buoy'. Who will be chosen to find today's exciting new word; Hari, Ela or Seren?

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ gabhail pàirt ann an latha chleasan nan Losgann. Ziff, Pipp and Button compete in their own Froggie sports day.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha seillean glacte ann an uamhag Bhernie agus, gun e air biadh fhaighinn, tha e cho fann ‘s nach dèan e a shlighe dhachaigh! Ge-tà, tha Oona ‘s Baba deònach a dhol a-lorg biadh dha gus am fàs e làidir a-rithist! There’s a bee trapped in Bernie’s grotto but without anything to eat, he has become too weak to escape and make his way back to the hive. However, Oona and Baba are on hand to find and bring him the food he needs to build his strength back up!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Mossy airson a dhol air turas-ionmhais bidhe ach ‘s ann a dh’ fheumas an sgioba dhol air misean-seilg' eadar-dhealaichte 's Pip ‘s Pop air a dhol am falach air Otto bochd! Mossy wants the gang to join him on a food hunt, but they are all called on a different sort of search when Pip and Pop decide to hide on poor Otto!

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha am Màidsear air fear de na h-innleachdan feumail aige a chruthachadh, ach chan eil còir aig duine beantainn ris fhad 's a tha e air falbh. Bu mhòr am beud nach do dh'èist Beag ris. Major has come up with one of his useful inventions, but no-one is allowed to touch it while he is away. It’s a shame that Beag didn’t listen to him.

programme.title: Orain CBeebies
programme.desc: Taghadh farsaing de dh’òrain bho Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh agus sgioba CBeebies ALBA. A selection of songs from Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh and the CBeebies ALBA presenters.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Iain MacAonghais a’ leughadh Measgaichte. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Arree Chung agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Mòrag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Iain MacInnes reads Measgaichte, written and illustrated by Arree Chung and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Man Ray rents Squidward's house. Tha An Sòrnan a’ gabhail taigh Ghiobaird air mhàl.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Leis mar a chaidh sgrùdadh na sgoile an-uiridh, tha bòrd na sgoile air Leas-Cheannard ùr, Ms Dallas, a thoirt a-steach gus sùil ghèir a chumail air Mgr Mackle. Bidh sinn a' coinneachadh ri tidsearean ùra agus ri feadhainn air a bheil sinn air eòlas a chuir roimhe. After last year’s school inspection, the school board has appointed a new deputy head, Ms Dallas, to keep an eye on Mr Mackle. We meet new teachers alongside some recognisable personalities.

programme.title: Alba Eagalach
programme.desc: Tha sgioba CBBC ALBA a’ toirt thugainn cuid de na sgeulachdan agus na tachartasan as eagalaiche ann an eachdraidh na h-Alba. Anns a’ phrògram seo, coinnichidh sinn ri Uilleam Uallas agus cluinnidh sinn mun bheatha eagalach a bh’ aige ach chan eil e fhèin ro dheònach bruidhinn mu dheidhinn! CBBC ALBA brings us some of the scariest stories from Scottish history. In this episode, we meet William Wallace and uncover the grisly details of his life. Surprisingly, he doesn't seem too keen to talk about these!

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Mar ‘s àbhaist, tha Coinneach Clogaid a’ feuchainn ri casg a chur air a h-uile Farpaiseach eile. Na can rium gu bheil e dol a bhuannachadh an trup-sa, ge-tà? ‘S cinnteach nach eil? As ever, Coinneach Clogaid is trying to stop all the other competitors. Don’t tell me he’s going to win this time though. Surely not?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha mòran ri innse an-diugh – mar a theich Sebastian ri Linn burraidheachd Chamshron, is tha sinn cuideachd ’g ionnsachadh mun chiad choinneachadh le Belle. There’s much to tell today - how Sebastian decided to run away as a result of Cameron’s bullying, and we learn about his first meeting with Belle.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha an tuathanach a' co-dhùnadh raon goilf a thogail air an tuathanas gus aire an sguibhir ionadail a ghlacadh. Nuair a mhothachas an treud gun caill iad an dump aca air a bheil iad cho dèidheil, feumaidh iad a thighinn an àrda le plana innleachdail gus a shàbhaladh. The farmer decides to build a golf course on the farm to impress the local squire. When the flock discover they'll lose their beloved dump, they must come up with an imaginative solution to try and save it.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Tha Bagelean Abigail fìor bhlast' agus sònraicht' 'son bruinse no lòn, no fiù 's aig àm sam bith, 's 'ad gad shàsachadh ann an dòigh nach gabh inns' 's iad fèìr taght' 'son an roinn leis an teaghlach no le caraidean. Abigail’s bagels are a very special and tasty brunch or lunch, or anytime experience, satisfying to the extreme and just the thing to share with family and friends. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Iseabail NicAsgailll. Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Ishbel MacAskill. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Bus Ghlaschu/Glasgow Bus
programme.desc: Bus Ghlaschu - sreath à Èirinn a’ toirt sùil air na caractaran air a’ bhus eadar Glaschu is Dùn nan Gall is na sgeulachdan timcheall air na tursan aca. A look at the characters and stories around the bus that runs between Donegal and Glasgow.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Seo an fharpais-cheist far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Le Niall Iain Dòmnhallach aig an stiùir cluichidh na sgiobaidhean anns an stiùideo an aghaidh an ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a tha a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin agus a tha a’ cur nan ceistean. A’ strì an aghaidh na Mas Fhìoraich airson feuchainn air an duais mhòr, tha DK is Kenna agus Kirsty is Seònaid. Presented by Niall Iain MacDonald, this is the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Playing from the comfort of their own homes are the Pretenders, and they are the ones posing the questions. Battling the Pretenders to win the big prize are DK and Kenna, and Kirsty and Janet. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Third Lanark
programme.desc: Ann an 1967, agus e faisg air ceud bliadhna a dh'aois, chaidh cluba ball-coise le eachdraidh shòisealta is chultarail sònraichte à bith. As dèidh 95 bliadhna de dh'eachdraidh phròiseil chaidh innse gun robh Cluba Lùth-chleasachd Third Lanark banc-briste, agus chaidh na geataichean gu Pàirce Chathkin an dùnadh airson an turas mu dheireadh. Tha Third Lanark ag innse an sgeulachd mu dheidhinn cluba coimhearsnachd sònraichte, a' coimhead ri mar a chaidh a stèidheachadh, na làithean buidhe a thuilleadh air na làithean a bu dhuirche an uair a chaidh an cluba à bith. In 1967, as it edged towards its centenary, a much-loved social and cultural institution was consigned to history. Following 95 years of emotional highs and lows, Glasgow's Third Lanark Athletic Club was bankrupt, and the gates to Cathkin Park were closed. Third Lanark is the fascinating story of this iconic community club, exploring its formation and existence, as well as its catastrophic collapse.

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean/Wild Senses
programme.desc: Tha Còmhraidhean Ceimigeach a’ toirt sùil air mar a tha beathaichean a’ dèananmh feum de bhlas agus fàileadh airson conaltradh agus maireachdainn beò ann an dòighean do-chreidsinneach. This episode tunes into how animals use taste and smell to survive and communicate in ways that defy belief. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Last of the Hunters ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Last of the Hunters in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. A’ taisbeanaidh chlàraidhean is chòmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh aig àm Celtic Connections 2024, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Talisk, Julie Fowlis/Éamon Doorley/Zoë Conway/John Mc Intyre, Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols agus Pine Tree Flyers. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Talisk; Julie Fowlis, Éamon Doorley, Zoë Conway, John McIntyre; Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols and Pine Tree Flyers. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ice Cold in Alex
programme.desc: During the German offensive in Libya in 1942, Captain Anson, commander of a motor ambulance convoy, finds himself cut off from his unit with only an old ambulance to take him back to Alexandria. His companions are two young nurses and his sergeant, Tom Pugh. As the little party sets off on the long journey, they meet Van der Poel, a South African captain who begs a lift.

programme.title: The Prince, the Showgirl and Me
programme.desc: Documentary. Sir Laurence Olivier's personal assistant Colin Clark reveals the trials that beset The Prince and the Showgirl film with Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: My Week with Marilyn
programme.desc: It is 1956, and The Prince and the Showgirl is being made at Pinewood Studios in London, directed by and starring Laurence Olivier, who has recruited one of the biggest Hollywood stars of all time, Marilyn Monroe, to co-star with him. Colin Clark, a junior assistant on the production, is assigned the job of looking after Marilyn and keeps a journal about the week he spent with her. It proves to be a turbulent experience as Marilyn is going through marital problems with her husband and uses Colin as a much-needed sounding board for all her pent-up neurosis. Acclaimed drama from BBC Films based on Clark's real-life diaries.

programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: Marilyn Monroe was, and perhaps will always be, Hollywood’s biggest female film icon and the sexiest of cinema's sex symbols, lighting up the screen in several cinema classics – including one of cinema’s greatest comedies, Some Like It Hot. The aura surrounding her has been enhanced by a sense of mystery that comes from the fact she was very rarely interviewed. But anyone who knew or worked with her was guaranteed to be asked about their personal 'Marilyn moments'. Here we tell Marilyn's story through the insights and anecdotes of friends, directors and fellow actors who spoke about her over the years on a selection of BBC programmes. With archive interviews featuring stars like Jane Russell, Jack Lemmon and Tony Curtis, as well as directors like Billy Wilder and John Huston, and Marilyn's former husband Arthur Miller, these conversations paint a picture of a star who conquered Hollywood despite serious battles with her inner demons, and reveal what it was like for those who got to enter into the orbit of one of cinema's greatest stars.

programme.title: Eve and Marilyn
programme.desc: 'She had a total understanding and control of the still camera... she was intelligent enough and sharp enough and beautiful enough to be able to manipulate almost any situation, so it became something which was totally her own...' Eve Arnold, one of the world's leading photo-journalists, remembers photographing Marilyn Monroe over the ten crucial years of Marilyn's stardom and decline. Going back to the original contact sheets and colour material, she tells of their friendship and what it was like as a woman to photograph Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: Steeplejack Fred Dibnah tours Britain admiring some of its engineering marvels. This edition focuses on structures that have been built for arts, leisure and entertainment purposes, including the Globe Theatre, the Victoria and Albert Museum and Blackpool Tower.

programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: Twelve journeys through six centuries of warfare in the company of Professor Richard Holmes. In May 1940, the Germans staged a lightning invasion of Belgium and France in a new kind of armoured warfare called blitzkrieg. Richard Holmes traces their route to the French city of Arras, where a small British force launched a counterattack that gave the allies vital breathing space.

programme.title: Jeff Buckley: Everybody Here Wants You
programme.desc: Jeff Buckley, a prodigiously talented guitarist and songwriter, drowned accidentally in 1997 at the age of 30. Actor Brad Pitt, fellow musicians and Buckley's mother are among those contributing to this portrait of a cult performer who, with his 1994 album Grace, emerged as one of the most acclaimed, eclectic and original rock artists of recent times.

programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: Could an AI ever be conscious? And if it were, how would we know? Thomas Germain and Jessica Maddox put the question to philosopher Jeff Sebo, director of the Center for Mind, Ethics, and Policy at New York University. Jeff isn't claiming AI is conscious, and he's clear that nobody knows for sure. His argument is that the possibility is real enough to study properly and plan for now, rather than scrambling after the fact as we did with animals and the climate. He explains what consciousness and sentience actually mean, why 'it's just software' doesn't settle the matter, and why the very idea makes so many people so angry. Thomas and Jess push back with the big objections. Shouldn't we fix the problems facing humans first? And can we trust AI companies to give us straight answers?

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: The latest news, sport, business and weather from the BBC's Breakfast team.

programme.title: Morning Live
programme.desc: Rav Wilding and Michelle Ackerley are joined by Angela Scanlon to discuss her new BBC Radio 2 show. Also on the show, your rights when holidays go wrong, what to do after a burglary, the dangers of deepfakes, and advice on burning mouth syndrome. Dani Dyer explores parenting, Jack Baddams shares birdwatching tips and Dr Ranj completes his Couch to 5K challenge.

programme.title: Dashcam Justice
programme.desc: Cyclist James Taylor's ride home in Bristol turns terrifying when a driver follows dangerously close, then squeezes past. His cameras capture the angry confrontation. An insurer questions a whiplash claim after a barely visible bump, while a horse rider films an overtake that nearly ends in a head-on crash. A van runs a red light, but tracing the driver brings an unexpected twist.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A newbie Derbyshire developer admits he's winging it! In Bournemouth, Martin is gobsmacked by the building he's in. Jacqui is in a Norfolk village called Little Snoring, but there's no time for her to take a nap with a property to see.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Will it be game, set and match for Ben Cooper’s or Kate Bliss’s team on this episode? In Box, near Bath, presenter Caroline Hawley visits the UK’s only tennis ball manufacturer, where she learns about the origins of the tennis ball and how it gets its all-important bounce! Hoping to ace it at the fair are friends Helen and Marsha on the red team. Their opponents in blue are pals Clark and Michele, who are in it ‘for gavels and fame’. With 60 minutes on the clock, they take a shine to a Georgian-style silver serving dish – but not the three-figure price tag! The reds’ first stop is a striking pair of arts and crafts copper candlesticks, but the cost quickly snuffs out their interest in them. At Tim Weeks’s auction in Wiltshire, the bidders snap up the teams’ items. Will it come down to a battle of the bonus buys?

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: The cryptocurrency scammers based in Albania are back at it as the team listen in. This group claim to help their victims recover lost investments, but in reality, they are just looking to steal more money. With efforts to get through on the phone failing, the ground team are dispatched to try to prevent a woman from Woking paying out, but local roadworks throw a spanner into the plan. As the scam nears its conclusion, Nick and Harleen watch on helplessly as ground interceptors Meea and Harriet do their utmost to beat the traffic and reach the woman in time. The team also join forces with ethical hacker Dan to investigate and confront a man from Cameroon claiming to sell horses on social media.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When a group of odd-job workmen turn up at Linda’s 87-year-old father's house saying he needs work doing, she races over before he parts with potentially hundreds of pounds. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan gets his hands dirty as he shows how our rubbish can be a treasure trove for criminals. And Matt speaks to a man who chased down a gang of suspected car thieves all by himself.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: It’s sea breezes and fresh starts in Devon as Nicki Chapman helps retirees from Northamptonshire find their perfect coastal retreat. They’re dreaming of a single-storey home close to the sea, and one of the properties delivers breathtaking ocean views right from the terrace. Nicki also meets a couple raising a family in a Dartmoor village, who share their love of the outdoors by mapping walks in the National Park for all ages and abilities to enjoy.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dom and plaster expert Rich try to preserve some World War II Polish art before it is lost forever. Meanwhile, David Burville repairs a clockwork ship, and Will gets to grips with shinty.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Eric Knowles visits Nottingham’s Gothic revival cathedral to learn how conservators are revealing 19th-century artwork under decades of plaster and paint. Designed in 1842 by architect Augustus Pugin, the cathedral’s interior was whitewashed in the 1960s. Pugin is widely admired for his work on some of Britain’s most famous buildings, including the Palace of Westminster. Conservator Ana Logreira shows Eric how they are using digitally created stencils to renovate the cathedral’s historic interior. At Southwell Racecourse in Nottinghamshire, red team uncle and niece Russ and Lily are up against twin sisters Angie and Tamsin in blue. With just 60 minutes to buy three items, Russ makes an early pit stop at a stall selling boxed toy cars. Meanwhile, a marcasite brooch catches the sisters’ attention, but expert Irita Marriott isn’t convinced it will dazzle the bidders. Trying to hammer out a profit for the teams in Nottingham is auctioneer Hettie Jago, who has her eye on the jewellery among the lots.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Three generations of the same family need help from Jules Hudson to find them a new, rural Norfolk home. In the kitty is £800,000 for a four-bedroom house, an annexe for Granny and enough land for a Shetland pony. Jules also needs a keen eye to spot some of the world’s rarest (and camera-shy) species of deer and antelope at a local safari park.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: In this episode, the experts lend their skills to a community project, hear the story behind a new treasure to be repaired and visit a local crafting hero. York Minster is one of our most magnificent cathedrals, boasting the world’s largest expanse of medieval stained glass. But the stonework of this glorious gothic monument is crumbling away on a daily basis. Will and Dom join the new generation of stonemasons being trained to save it, harnessing modern technology while still using centuries-old skills. Will’s Yorkshire odyssey continues in Cawthorne, where Elwin presents him with a huge drum that has been owned by the local marching band since the 1850s. The damaged paintwork, ill-fitting skins and loose cords aren’t befitting such a magnificent instrument, so percussion expert Pete Woods takes on the mammoth task of getting it back into a playable condition. Dom heads further south through God’s Own Country to visit occasional Repair Shop expert Jonathan Reid in his Sheffield workshop. Here the master putter, or scissor-maker, is keeping the endangered craft of making scissors by hand alive, and he’s eager to share some secrets of the trade with his fellow craftsman.

programme.title: Return to Paradise
programme.desc: Lights, camera, murder. The anniversary screening of Dolphin Cove cult horror film Blood Wave goes off with a literal bang when one of its key creatives is killed during the iconic gunshot sequence. But how did the killer fire the gun in front of the packed house without the audience realising? Theories abound, and not just about the murder, as Colin questions what significance the film holds for Mack and Glenn. And as the case builds to its climax, Mackenzie doesn't know whether it's harder to solve the crime or give Leo an answer when he asks her out on a date.

programme.title: Bill's Included
programme.desc: When Bill’s wife walks out on him for the gardener, he’s left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students. Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates: Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James. But when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, Bill has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord. Bill’s best mate, Drew, gives him the idea to deploy an anonymous suggestions box, but this backfires when the students’ requests lead to the worst night’s sleep of his life. Bill’s neighbour and secret crush, Siobhan, suggests sending over her intimidating husband, Martin, to complain on Bill’s behalf, but when this ruse is exposed, Bill fears the students will leave him, just like his wife did. He’s grateful to learn that not only do they have nowhere else to live but they forgive him, since university is all about starting over. For better or worse, his new life truly has begun.

programme.title: Rush Hour 3
programme.desc: East meets West when the assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: Captain John Miller (Tom Hanks) takes his men behind enemy lines to find Private James Ryan, whose three brothers have been killed in combat. Surrounded by the brutal realties of war, while searching for Ryan, each man embarks upon a personal journey and discovers their own strength to triumph over an uncertain future with honor, decency and courage.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: U.S. Navy pilot Lt. Jake Grafton (Brad Johnson) and his bombardier buddy, Lt. Cmdr. Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed.

programme.title: World Trade Center
programme.desc: Two Port Authority officers, Sgt. John McLoughlin (Nicolas Cage) and Officer Will Jimeno (Michael Peña), become trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center after going in to help people escape from the buildings during the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001.

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface.

programme.title: Jacob's Ladder
programme.desc: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer (Tim Robbins) struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie (Elizabeth Peña), and ex-wife, Sarah (Patricia Kalember), try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis (Danny Aiello), fails to reach him as he descends into madness.

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator.

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime.

programme.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: As Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) ages, he finds that being the head of the Corleone crime family isn't getting any easier. He wants his family out of the Mafia, but the mob kingpin (Eli Wallach) isn't eager to let one of the most powerful and wealthy families go legit. Making matters even worse is Michael's nephew, Vincent (Andy Garcia). Not only does Vincent want a piece of the Corleone family's criminal empire, but he also wants Michael's daughter, Mary (Sofia Coppola).

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is.

programme.title: A Simple Plan
programme.desc: While in the woods near their small town, upstanding local Hank Mitchell (Bill Paxton), his dim brother Jacob (Billy Bob Thornton) and their friend Lou (Brent Briscoe) discover a crashed plane with two things in it -- a dead pilot, and a stash of more than four million dollars. Although Hank is reluctant to keep the money, Jacob and Lou convince him otherwise, and they devise a plan to split the fortune. Things quickly go wrong, however, dramatically affecting the trio and those around them.

programme.title: Roadracers
programme.desc: In the 1950s, Dude Delaney (David Arquette) is a guitar-playing drifter who wanders into a quiet town looking to play music and generally cause trouble, much to the chagrin of the local sheriff (William Sadler). While palling around with his B-movie-obsessed friend, Nixer (John Hawkes), Dude meets a beautiful woman by the name of Donna (Salma Hayek), and is offered a position in a rockabilly band, but the sheriff is intent on getting rid of him by any means necessary.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: When God decides that mankind has become too sinful and must be wiped off the Earth, he chooses Noah (Russell Crowe), a pious man, for a great task. Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood.

programme.title: Sea Level
programme.desc: When poachers steal dozens of egg sacks from his reef, bamboo shark Pup makes it his personal mission to save his unhatched brothers and sisters. His rescue mission takes him above water into the world of man.

programme.title: Sea Level 2: Magic Arch
programme.desc: A young dolphin with an active imagination discovers a magic arch that makes wishes come true. However, when its enemies use the arch to become big and strong, it must find a way to stop them.

programme.title: Girl in Progress
programme.desc: Grace is a single mom who is often too busy juggling her job, bills and two love interests to pay much attention to her daughter, Ansiedad. Inspired by the coming-of-age stories her English teacher introduces in class, Ansiedad decides to skip adolescence and jump-start her life without her mother. But, when the misguided plan unravels, Ansiedad and Grace must both learn that growing up means acting your age.

programme.title: The Great Gilly Hopkins
programme.desc: Young and feisty Gilly Hopkins (Sophie Nélisse) devises a scheme to escape from her new foster home and reunite with her birth mother.

programme.title: Bart Got a Room
programme.desc: Everyone is searching for love in director Brian Hecker's semi-autobiographical story. Danny Stein, a high school senior at the bottom of the social food chain, needs a prom date. As a cause of anxiety for Danny, Bart Beeber, the nerdiest guy in school, has already found a date -- and booked a hotel room. At the same time, Danny's divorced parents are both looking for relationships again.

programme.title: Bandslam
programme.desc: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

programme.title: Bark Ranger
programme.desc: Jack lives in a national park with his mom, dad and dog Ranger, and when he meets Chloe, the two become fast friends. When Jack finds a treasure map, he and Chloe are kidnapped by robbers, and only Ranger can save the day.

programme.title: Paws P.I.
programme.desc: A boy recruits his talking dog and parrot to help him take down a tyrannical tycoon who's determined to stop a local mansion from being turned into an animal rescue.

programme.title: Happily N'Ever After 2: Snow White: Another Bite at the Apple
programme.desc: Snow White (Helen Niedwick) must prevent her father from marrying a scheming witch who wants to rule the kingdom.

programme.title: My Sweet Monster
programme.desc: Princess Barbara is secretly in love with Prince Edward. When the sneaky post clerk Weasel demands the king to marry him to Barbara, she flees. Sweet monster Bogey does everything in his might to help Barbara save the kingdom.

programme.title: A Dog and Pony Show
programme.desc: Dede, a famous performing circus dog, gets left behind when her show leaves town. When she is adopted by a lonely boy on a farm, the vain dog has to learn to get along with the other animals.

programme.title: H Is for Happiness
programme.desc: An optimistic 12-year-old girl hatches scheme after scheme to make her mother, father and uncle happy again.

programme.title: A Richer Christmas
programme.desc: When a wealthy family loses everything before the holidays, their world falls apart - but in the chaos, they discover the true meaning of Christmas.

programme.title: Jungle Master
programme.desc: Transported to a magical land, a girl (Victoria Justice) meets an emerging leader (Josh Peck) who must save the rain forest from an evil scientist.

programme.title: Leo the Lion
programme.desc: A young vegetarian lion is shunned by other carnivores.

programme.title: Face the Music
programme.desc: Lisa (Molly Ringwald) and Charlie Hunter (Patrick Dempsey) are an award-winning songwriting team -- that is, until the demise of their marriage ends their musical partnership. With divorce proceedings underway and Charlie already attached to a hot young girlfriend, it doesn't seem like they'll have a change of heart anytime soon. But, when a French movie producer makes them a lucrative offer to write a love song, they're forced to collaborate -- and bicker -- once more.

programme.title: Let Us In
programme.desc: A 12-year-old girl is determined to uncover who or what is behind the rash of disappearances occurring in her small town.

programme.title: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet
programme.desc: T.S. is invited to the Smithsonian to receive an award for inventing a perpetual motion machine. Without telling any of his family, he boards a freight train heading to Washington, D.C., to attend the ceremony.

programme.title: Time Freak
programme.desc: Dumped by his girlfriend, a young physics genius travels back in time to change the past and win her heart again.

programme.title: I Can Only Imagine 2
programme.desc: After the breakout success of the song "I Can Only Imagine," MercyMe's Bart Millard has it all until fame starts to cost him what matters most. When hopeful newcomer Tim Timmons joins the band for their biggest tour yet, he unknowingly brings a renewed gratitude to Bart's life. Based on the true story behind the hit single "Even If," the film is the inspiring next chapter of faith, family and finding God in the fire.

programme.title: Face the Music
programme.desc: Lisa (Molly Ringwald) and Charlie Hunter (Patrick Dempsey) are an award-winning songwriting team -- that is, until the demise of their marriage ends their musical partnership. With divorce proceedings underway and Charlie already attached to a hot young girlfriend, it doesn't seem like they'll have a change of heart anytime soon. But, when a French movie producer makes them a lucrative offer to write a love song, they're forced to collaborate -- and bicker -- once more.

programme.title: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet
programme.desc: T.S. is invited to the Smithsonian to receive an award for inventing a perpetual motion machine. Without telling any of his family, he boards a freight train heading to Washington, D.C., to attend the ceremony.

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: George embarks on a monumental and historical trip to Spain with Prince Charles in a bid to ease English and Spanish tensions and avoid war; Mary attempts one last throw of the dice to ensure absolute power.

programme.title: This Christmas
programme.desc: At holiday time, family matriarch Ma'Dere Whitfield (Loretta Devine) assembles her large brood for their first reunion in four years. However, family ties show signs of strain when various secrets come to light, especially concerning Marine Claude's (Columbus Short) true military status, Quentin's (Idris Elba) debts and teenage Baby's (Chris Brown) secret plans to become a singer.

programme.title: Wanderlust
programme.desc: George (Paul Rudd) and Linda (Jennifer Aniston) have overextended, overstressed lives in Manhattan. After George loses his job, he and Linda have little choice but to move to Atlanta and stay with his terrible brother. On the way, the couple happen upon Elysium, an idyllic counterculture community, where money, careers and clothing are strictly optional. George and Linda think that they can make a fresh start in Elysium, only they may be trading one set of problems for another.

programme.title: Priest
programme.desc: In a society ravaged by centuries of war between humans and vampires, a legendary warrior priest (Paul Bettany), a veteran of the last conflict, lives in an enclosed city ruled by the church. When a murderous pack of vampires kidnaps his niece (Lily Collins), the priest breaks his sacred vows and sets out to rescue her before the bloodsuckers put the bite on her. Joining him on his quest are his niece's boyfriend (Cam Gigandet) and a former priestess (Maggie Q) with supernatural fighting skills.

programme.title: In the Grey
programme.desc: A covert team of elite operatives live in the global shadows, as comfortable wielding power and influence as they are automatic weapons and high explosives. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, the team is sent to steal it back on what would be for anyone else a suicide mission. What begins as an impossible heist gets worse, spiraling into an all-out war of strategy, deception and survival.

programme.title: Mo' Money
programme.desc: After petty criminal Johnny (Damon Wayans) falls for the lovely Amber (Stacey Dash), he decides to stop breaking the law and gets a gig at his crush's workplace in order to get closer to her, thus proving that he's a stand-up guy. Soon, he learns that going straight doesn't pay very well, so he decides to nab a company credit card and show off his newfound wealth to Amber. Unfortunately, a blackmailer catches Johnny and forces him to commit a crime that is far from small.

programme.title: Splash City
programme.desc: While Slim sees basketball as a way out, his brother Juju falls deeper into street crime. Together they must choose between a brighter future and a violent legacy.

programme.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles
programme.desc: Sammy steps up to lead the team through its most delicate hostage situation yet when a former student returns to his old campus armed and hunting the people who failed him; the Exiles start to realize the real threat might already be wearing a badge.

programme.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles
programme.desc: When proof of a conspiracy reaching into the Mayor's office surfaces, Hondo is pulled into an off-the-books mission; as the Exiles close in on the truth, Hondo has to decide how far he's willing to go completely alone.

programme.title: The Bounce Back
programme.desc: Relationship expert Matthew Taylor (Shemar Moore) is on a book tour promoting his bestseller "The Bounce Back" when he meets talk show circuit therapist Kristin Peralta (Nadine Velazquez), who calls him out as a fraud. Matthew's life is upended when, in spite of himself, he falls in love with this quick-witted woman and is forced to face painful truths about a past relationship.

programme.title: Motives
programme.desc: A successful businessman (Shemar Moore) gets caught in a web of deceit after cheating on his wife (Vivica A. Fox).

programme.title: Motives 2: Retribution
programme.desc: A man (Brian J. White) cuts through lies and deceit to investigate the murder of his imprisoned brother (Shemar Moore).

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: Anti-Spanish riots have taken hold of the city, and with the Crown plunged into debt, George stands to lose everything; Mary faces devastating consequences when she overplays her hand.

programme.title: Marshall
programme.desc: Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty.

programme.title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!
programme.desc: The singer-songwriter performs a repertoire of her festive holiday hits, including the chart-topping perennial favorite "All I Want for Christmas Is You."

programme.title: The Preacher's Wife
programme.desc: A cleric begins to doubt himself and is visited by an angel. The heavenly emissary is supposed to help the good reverend over his midlife crisis, but he is distracted by the cleric's lovely young wife. A remake with gospel music of the "The Bishop's Wife".

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

programme.title: The Vow
programme.desc: Paige and Leo are happily married newlyweds, but their idyllic life together suddenly shatters when a car accident leaves her in a coma. When Paige awakes, she has severe memory loss and doesn't know Leo. She also has a confusing relationship with her parents and still harbors feelings for a former fiancé. Despite these difficult obstacles, Leo is determined to renew their bond and rebuild their marriage.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place.

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity.

programme.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood
programme.desc: Julia and Lovat attend an event honoring Loyalist Lairds who fought against Jacobites in the Rebellion; Ellen's longstanding plan to protect Leoch from the Crown is put to the test.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

programme.title: Pain & Gain
programme.desc: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story.

programme.title: Motives
programme.desc: A successful businessman (Shemar Moore) gets caught in a web of deceit after cheating on his wife (Vivica A. Fox).

programme.title: Motives 2: Retribution
programme.desc: A man (Brian J. White) cuts through lies and deceit to investigate the murder of his imprisoned brother (Shemar Moore).
